verdict.rationale: Gitleaks has no scheduler of its own. Recurring runs depend on an external host: the official gitleaks-action runs inside GitHub workflows, and gitleaks.io describes automatic scans on pull requests and commits plus on-demand scans. That is event-driven or manual automation, and the evidence never shows a time-based or cron schedule. Missing for 10: a native scheduling capability, documented cron or scheduled-workflow examples, and any evidence of recurring (rather than event-triggered) scan jobs.
